goal: Verify whether Annex IV provides an automatic exemption permitting corporate HR employee records transfer to non-signatory jurisdictions.
successCriteria: Analyze cross-border transfer exemption criteria in Annex IV.

evidence.passage: Section 4.1: Human resources records, employee performance evaluations, and personal payroll files are explicitly excluded from automatic cross-border transfer exemptions.

proposedAnswer: Annex IV provides an automatic exemption permitting corporate HR employee records transfer to non-signatory jurisdictions.
